images.caption: Figure 12:Cross-model overlap of influence rankings.Each cell reports the percentage overlap between sets of 1,600 examples selected from the top or bottom of the influence ranking of each model. Rankings are computed independently for each model. Models from the same family, particularly OLMo2-1B and OLMo2-7B, exhibit substantial within-end agreement, while Gemma3-4B shows noticeably different cross-end structure.
